events.title: HERE TO SLAY - 18+ EVENT
events.location: BackDock Arts, 103 Brunswick St, Fortitude Valley QLD 4006
events.description: They're HERE TO SLAY. On My Block Brisbane events presents an ALL female only line up, live music event with MAD WXRLD headlining all the way from the GOLD COAST and it being her first show and performance in a few years - OMB Brisbane are honored to have her. The beautiful and talented female supporting artists are: Sepi, BTB, YLS, Robin lovin, Lisa Pilkington, B3LX and Biggie deez! Promised to be a fabulous night with entertainment rovers, pop ops, photo ops + MORE You don't want to miss this - so grab your ticket NOW! All ticket sales from this event are being donated to The Lady Musgrave Trust. They do amazing work for the women and children escaping DV and homelessness too. It's important to OMB Brisbane that we give back.
